correctness.rationale: The proof reduces the rational skew product by its exact \(q\)-th iterate to a scalar twist. For any compact base, a fixed \(\varepsilon\)-cover of the base combined with \(O(n)\) bins in the bounded scalar velocity range and a fixed fiber net gives an explicit \((n,\varepsilon)\)-spanning set of size \(O_\varepsilon(n)\). Constant velocity gives an isometry. For nonconstant \(\Phi_q\), the rotation set is non-singleton and Corrêa\'s 2026 theorem gives the matching lower bound. The quantifiers, endpoints \(q=1\), and cancellation case where \(\phi\) is nonconstant but \(\Phi_q\) is constant were checked.
